methodology.signal: candidate list generated near/after signal-day close
methodology.execution: all buys, exits and rebalances use next-session first 5-minute VWAP
methodology.holding: setup/score initial horizon plus prior-close trend failure or extension; all decisions lagged one session
methodology.early_exit: prior close <=95% of anchor OR age>=2 and prior close below anchor, below 3-close average, non-positive 2-session momentum
methodology.extension: at/after base horizon, continue one session at a time only if prior close >101% anchor, >=3-close average, positive 2-session momentum
methodology.portfolio: if any active theses exist, rebalance full NAV at open-5m VWAP; no fixed 8 sleeves
